evidence: Single package (packages: 1) with no inter-service communication patterns
Clear logical separation into modules: models/, services/, utils/, config/, tests/, etc.
Central entry point (app.py) orchestrating components, no distributed endpoints
Services depend on models and utils directly (fan-out ~4, moderate coupling)
All components run in same process (Flask app, scheduled tasks, CLI scripts)
No external service boundaries or RPC patterns visible
Shared data models (Account, Entrypoint) used across services
Configuration and templates co-located, typical of monoliths
risks: Tight coupling between services (e.g., services/cloudflare.py imports services/common.py and vice versa)
Potential scalability limitations due to single-process deployment
Difficulty isolating failure domains without process boundaries
Testing may require heavy mocking due to cross-module dependencies
